subject: 757tech Monthly: Hacktoberfest, BSides, and Pop-up Meetup #2
preheader: BSides Hampton Roads is Oct 9–10, Hacktoberfest Hack Day is Oct 17, and our next Pop-up Meetup lands Oct 22.
disclaimer: You're receiving this newsletter because you registered for or attended a RevolutionVA event. If you'd like to [unsubscribe]({{ visitor.unsubscribe_url }}), we understand.
greeting: Happy Friday! October is shaping up to be one of the busiest months Hampton Roads tech has seen in a while — a security conference, a hack day, and our second Pop-up Meetup, all in the span of two weeks. Here's what's coming up.

items.title: BSides Hampton Roads
items.lead: BSides Hampton Roads is a community-driven cybersecurity conference built to connect, educate, and inspire the local security community. It's part of the global Security BSides movement — open, collaborative, and welcoming to professionals, students, researchers, and the security-curious alike.
items.when: October 9th–10th, 2026 at the ODU Webb University Center, Norfolk

items.title: Hacktoberfest Hack Day Hampton x RevolutionVA
items.lead: Spend a Saturday building in the open. This year's theme is open-source AI: bring a project you've been meaning to try, experiment with an open-weight model, tinker with an open-source agent, or just find someone to build with.
items.imageAlt: Hacktoberfest Hack Day Hampton x RevolutionVA
items.when: October 17th, 2026, 10 am–4 pm at 757 Makerspace, Hampton
body: It's open to all ages, and you don't have to live in Hampton — if you're willing to make the trip, come on out. Breakfast refreshments and lunch are provided; bring a laptop and charger.

items.title: Pop-up Meetup: Agent Incident Response and Retros
items.lead: Pop-up Meetup #2 brings Mike Rollins to The Hive to talk about incidents where an AI agent was part of the problem. Agents can take actions a system would never normally take, which widens the blast radius and makes the retro harder. You may need to rebuild the conversation across several agents and read their thinking traces just to see what happened.
items.imageAlt: Pop-up Meetup at The Hive, guest Mike Rollins, in front of a full auditorium
items.when: October 22nd, 2026, 6 pm at The Hive, Virginia Beach
body: Mike will go through real agent incidents and retros, plus the Hugging Face incident, and pull out what may be the first best practices for handling them. Food and drinks are provided. Bring questions and a friend.

items.title: Pop-up Meetup #1
body: Our first Pop-up Meetup packed The Hive on August 27th. More than 35 of you came out to hear Hampton Roads DevFest alum Ryan Castillo take on the AI doom and hype — where AI actually earns its keep in your day-to-day work, where it wastes your time, and where you're still the best person for the job.
items.photoAlt: Ryan Castillo takes a selfie from the podium at The Hive with a room of cheering Pop-up Meetup attendees behind him
bodyAfterPhoto: Thanks to Ryan, and to everyone who showed up and kept the conversation going afterward. Pop-up #2 is on the calendar above — see you there.

items.title: 757tech in WHRO
body: WHRO came out to see what we're building. Reporter Ashley White spent time with the community and wrote [Through 757 Tech, developers and programmers in Hampton Roads find community](https://www.whro.org/business-growth/2026-09-02/through-757-tech-developers-and-programmers-in-hampton-roads-find-community) — a look at why so many of you keep showing up.
items.photoAlt: Attendees at a 757tech workshop working on laptops around tables in a sunlit conference room, one person standing and talking with a seated participant whose laptop is covered in stickers
bodyAfterPhoto: “Everybody in this community has been the warmest, most wholesome group of people that I think I've ever met.” — Chazona Baum, speaking to WHRO

The piece covers HTML Day, the Late Night Builders crew, and the JavaScript, AI, and cybersecurity meetups that fill the calendar week to week. Thanks to Ashley and WHRO, and to Chazona Baum and Paul Chin for talking with them. Photo by Ashley White / WHRO.
